expected: interior peak, decays to near zero, mass conserved

claim: reducing beta, raising gamma, lowering sigma each flatten or delay the curve
expected: beta=0.5 flatter; gamma=0.5 flatter; sigma=0.1 later peak

claim: every equilibrium of the basic SEIR model is disease-free
expected: RHS residual = 0 at (s, 0, 0, r); long solve drives e, i -> 0

claim: influx turns the disease-free equilibrium into an endemic one near 5%
expected: i settles at approximately 0.05, not decaying to 0

claim: R0 = beta*s0/gamma separates outbreak from no outbreak
vaccinating fraction v scales R0 by (1 - v); threshold at R0 = 1
